spans.s:
The affix क्यङ् in the sense of 'feeling', comes after the words सुख 'pleasure' etc. when the pleasure etc. belong to the agent as feels thereof.

Terms: क्यङ्

The affix इनि (इन्) comes (to the exclusion of other affixes) in the sense of मतुप् after the words सुख etc.

Terms: इनि (इन्)

The affix डाच् comes after the words 1. सुख and 2. प्रिय followed by कृ 'to make' when the meaning is ('to concede', 'gratify') 'to go with the grain'.

Terms: डाच्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'to feel delight' or 'is good'.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास
